content.overview: Fixed-size circular buffer with monotonic read/write counters. SPSC case is lockless: producer owns in-counter, consumer owns out-counter, memory-ordering points replace locks. Capacity MUST be a power of two so index = counter & mask.

operations.name: kfifo_in
operations.contract: copy min(n, avail); smp_wmb BEFORE publishing new in-counter; returns elements written

operations.name: kfifo_out
operations.contract: copy min(n, len); smp_rmb AFTER payload read BEFORE publishing out-counter

invariants: capacity power of two; index = counter & mask everywhere
counters never reset in normal operation; unsigned wrap correct by design
SPSC lockless safety depends on both barrier points; removing them is a data race on ARM/RISC-V
MPMC requires external serialization; NOT covered by this card
content.usage_contract: Writer checks kfifo_avail, reader checks kfifo_len; partial-op return value is authoritative.
verification_questions: size power of two and mask used instead of %?
write barrier between payload store and in-counter store?
read barrier between payload load and out-counter store?
can len/avail tear on 32-bit? (single unsigned load required)

provenance.note: origin is audit metadata only; all knowledge physically embedded
